title: Utility: Quest v3 sets-only comparison (boundary@2e-8, Top-K 1e-9/1e-8) + dual-tol gate on Noesis geometry
abstract: Parses Quest’s new sets-only CSVs (boundary@2e-8; Top‑K slack K=25@1e−9, K=15@1e−8), computes boundary Jaccard vs Noesis boundary derived from snapshot slacks at 2e−8, computes Top‑K Jaccards vs Noesis interior Top‑K (boundary filter@1e−8), and tests the dual‑tolerance crossing‑quad gate on Noesis geometry. Logs JSON; returns baseline pack.
